cards.text: Meet Paul and Barnabas, two men carrying the good news about Jesus from town to town. They just got driven out of Pisidian Antioch and shook the dust off their feet on the way out (Acts 13:50-51). Now they're in Iconium, and as usual, first stop: the Jewish synagogue.

cards.question: In the synagogue at Iconium, Paul and Barnabas speak so well that something big happens. What is it?

answers.text: A great number of Jews and Greeks believe
The leaders ask them to preach every Sabbath
The rulers invite them to speak at the palace

cards.text: But the unbelieving Jews stir up the Gentiles and poison their minds against the brothers. Big win, then trouble, just like my best batch ever, which I dropped on the way to the cooling rack.

cards.question: With minds in Iconium getting poisoned against them, Paul and Barnabas leave town right away.
Paul and Barnabas keep speaking boldly for the Lord in Iconium. How does the Lord back up the message of His grace?

answers.text: He enables them to perform signs and wonders
He sends an angel to stand guard beside them
He makes the city rulers protect them

cards.text: Now the city is divided, some siding with the Jews and some with the apostles. It's the office group chat after somebody touched the thermostat.
Then it turns ugly. The Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat Paul and Barnabas and stone them.

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas find out about the plan to stone them in Iconium. What do they do?
Once they reach Lystra and Derbe, Paul and Barnabas keep preaching the gospel.

cards.text: In Lystra there's a man sitting, crippled in his feet. He's been lame from birth and has never walked.

cards.question: The man in Lystra is listening to Paul. Paul looks intently at him and sees that he has ___ to be healed.
In a loud voice, Paul calls out to the man who has never walked, "Stand up on your feet!" What does the man do?

answers.text: He jumps up and begins to walk
He stands but cannot take a step
He asks Paul to pray for him first

cards.text: The crowds in Lystra just watched a man who never walked JUMP to his feet. They lift up their voices in the Lycaonian language: "The gods have come down to us in human form!"

cards.question: The crowd in Lystra decides Paul and Barnabas are gods. What do they call Barnabas?
The crowd calls Paul Hermes, because he is the chief ___.

cards.text: The priest of Zeus, whose temple is just outside the city, brings bulls and wreaths to the city gates. Friend, that is a LOT of planning for a misunderstanding.

cards.question: What is the priest of Zeus hoping to do with the bulls and wreaths at the city gates?

answers.text: Offer a sacrifice along with the crowds
Crown Paul and Barnabas as kings
Lead a parade through the whole city

cards.question: When Barnabas and Paul find out about the sacrifice, they tear their clothes.

cards.text: They rush into the crowd, shouting, "Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you." Meanwhile, somebody compliments ONE of my cookies and I start signing autographs.

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas tell the crowd to turn from these ___ things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.

cards.text: Then they tell the crowd that in past generations, God let all nations go their own way.

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas say God has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness. What do they point to?

answers.text: Rain from heaven and fruitful seasons
Stars that light up the night sky

cards.question: Once Paul and Barnabas finish speaking, the crowds in Lystra calm down easily.

cards.text: Then some Jews arrive from Pisidian Antioch and Iconium and win over the same crowds that wanted to sacrifice to Paul and Barnabas. Friend, that's a U-turn with NO blinker.
They stone Paul and drag him outside the city. This part is heavy.

cards.question: The people who dragged Paul outside the city of Lystra think he is dead.
The disciples gather around Paul outside the city. What does Paul do?

answers.text: Gets up and goes back into the city
Asks them to carry him to Derbe
Rests outside the city for a week

cards.text: The next day Paul leaves with Barnabas for Derbe.
Paul and Barnabas make it to Derbe and preach the gospel to that city.

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas preach the gospel in Derbe. How does it go?
After Derbe, Paul and Barnabas steer clear of Lystra and Iconium on the way home.
Back in Lystra, Iconium and Pisidian Antioch, what do Paul and Barnabas do for the disciples?

answers.text: Strengthen them and urge them to keep the faith
Collect money for the church in Jerusalem
Tell them to move somewhere much safer

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas tell the disciples they must endure many ___ to enter the kingdom of God.
Before moving on, Paul and Barnabas set something up in each church. What do they do?
As they appoint elders in each church, Paul and Barnabas fast.

cards.text: After passing through Pisidia, they come to Pamphylia and speak the word in Perga. That's the same Perga where John, their helper, left them to go back to Jerusalem (Acts 13:5, 13).

cards.question: After speaking the word in Perga, Paul and Barnabas go down to ___.

cards.text: From Attalia they sail to Antioch, not Pisidian Antioch but the Antioch where this whole journey started (Acts 13:1-3). That's where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed. Full circle, friend.

cards.question: Back in the Antioch where their journey started, Paul and Barnabas gather the church together. What do they do?

answers.text: Report all that God had done through them
Ask the church to send a bigger team
Choose who goes on the next trip

cards.question: Paul and Barnabas tell the church how God opened the door of faith to the ___.

cards.text: And they spend a long time there with the disciples. Home sweet Antioch, friend.
